title: Rukkha
text: 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānam rukkhā Pāricchattako tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci bodhapakkhikā dhammā paññindriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam bodhāya || || 3. Katame ca bhikkhave bodhapakkhikā dhammā || || saddhindriyam bhikkhave bodhapakkhiko dhammo tam bodhāya saṃvattati || pa [pe] || paññindriyam bodhapakkhiko dhammo tam bodhāya saṃvattati || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ rukkhā Pāricchattako tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci bodhapakkhikā dhammā paññindriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam bodhāyā ti || ||
